integrity: Proof uses coefficient-matrix rank bounds with an exact unimodular 59 by 59 minor over integers and a nonsingular 55 by 55 binary minor. Standalone scripts recompute both certificates and perform a direct 1024-input binary verification. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Full classification concerns only ground-field-linear maps on N_5 of finite fields. Explicit nonstandard binary maps exist in each N_n for n at least five, but are not claimed exhaustive beyond size five. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: A binary-field exception in power-commuting maps of strictly triangular matrices
